pay_detail: 2026 total was $5,991 for commuters and $7,875 for residential students. 2027 rates post Dec 17.
duration: 3 weeks. 2027 dates (pending approval): June 27 to July 16 or July 18 to Aug 6
name: Academic Immersion (AIM)
what_you_do: A three week program with no college credit. You pick one subject. In 2026 the choices were psychology, medicine, creative writing and business. You also do activities in Boston.
who_can_apply: Students who start their junior or senior year in fall 2027. Students from other countries can apply.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open Dec 17, 2026. Close date not posted. The page says to check back Dec 17 for 2027 details.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Academic Immersion page. See the How to Apply page after Dec 17.
notes: Costs money. The 2027 price is not posted yet. The course page does not say whether it gives college credit.
